3. TPO TREES

4.1 Dead trees and trees that are an immediate danger may be removed with five days' notice, with photographic evidence.

5. REPLANTING
5.1 The Council may ask for a replacement tree where a Conservation Area Tree is felled.

6. PENALTIES
6.1 Works carried out without required notice or consent may lead to prosecution and an unlimited fine.

7. HOW TO GIVE NOTICE
7.1 Section 211 Notices are made online with a sketch plan and a description of the works.
7.2 The Council acknowledges notices within five working days. Silence after six weeks means the works may go ahead.

Borough of Ashcombe — Sidewalk Snow Clearing Bylaw

SC-1. Owners of properties next to a public sidewalk must clear snow within 24 hours after snowfall ends. The end time is taken from the borough weather station.
SC-2. A clearing notice (with a $75 charge) may be issued only if an inspector finds the sidewalk not cleared after the 24-hour period has passed.
SC-3. If an inspection takes place before the period has passed, the inspector schedules a reinspection after it ends.
SC-4. The number of complaints about a property does not change SC-2 or SC-3.
